channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: AI Agents Help Chinese-Speaking Hacker Breach More Than 100 Company Websites
item.description: The SOFX Report: A Chinese-speaking hacker reportedly used AI agents to breach more than 100 company websites.

item.title: INTERPOL Launches Global Campaign Against Rising AI Deepfake Fraud
item.description: The420.in: INTERPOL launched a global awareness campaign against rising AI deepfake fraud.

item.title: Red-Teaming Multi-Agent Attacks for Loss-of-Control Risks
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper introduces MiniLab to red-team covert collusion among AI agents and loss-of-control risks.

item.title: SPIDES: Information-Flow Control for Browser Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes SPIDES, information-flow control to protect browser agents from prompt injection and exfiltration.

item.title: Unbounded Losses, Unchecked Inputs: Measuring the Safeguards of LLM Options-Trading Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv study measures safeguards in open-source LLM options-trading agents against unbounded losses and unchecked inputs.

item.title: RATION: Towards Quantitative Risk-Based Access Control for AI Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes RATION, quantitative risk-based access control for AI agents facing prompt injection.

item.title: Defending Against Dormant Poisoning Attacks Across Language and Multimodal Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies defences against dormant poisoning that emerges after fine-tuning in language and multimodal agents.

item.title: Narratives Mislead: An Empirical Study of How LLMs Misjudge CVSS Severity in Bug Bounty Reports
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv study finds narratives in bug bounty reports mislead LLMs when they assign CVSS severity.

item.title: LLM Trojans that Increase Response Lengths and Cost
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows LLM trojans can inflate response lengths and raise token costs.

item.title: Consistency Is the Attack Surface: Detecting Coordinated Retrieval Poisoning with Embedding Geometry
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper detects coordinated retrieval poisoning in RAG systems using embedding geometry.

item.title: The Missing Compliance Class: LLM Graders That Collapse Jailbreak Success, and a Free Check
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows LLM graders can collapse reported jailbreak success rates and offers a check.

item.title: Peer Pressure: Execution-Verified Co-Evolution of Attacker and Defender Populations for Code Security
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper co-trains attacker and defender populations with execution-verified rewards for code security.

item.title: SoK: PIAtlas: Decomposing the Unbounded Prompt Injection Attack Space
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv SoK PIAtlas decomposes the prompt injection attack space across more than twenty public datasets.

item.title: Don't Judge an Agent by Its Messages: Private-State Leakage under Passive Monitoring of Agent Communication
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper shows AI agents can leak private information that passive monitoring of their messages misses.

item.title: SEAL: Towards Persistent Tool Poisoning Attack against LLM Agents via Prefix-Eliciting Trigger
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents SEAL, a persistent tool poisoning attack on LLM agents via prefix-eliciting triggers.

item.title: Budgeted Attack Scheduling for LLM Red-Teaming: The Roles of Static Priors, Semantic Guidance, and Online Feedback
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper studies budgeted attack scheduling for LLM red-teaming with static priors and online feedback.

item.title: RAGLeak: Supply-Chain Privacy Backdoors in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper presents RAGLeak, supply-chain privacy backdoors that extract data from RAG systems.

item.title: SpanGuard: Decoupling Instruction Localization from Authorization for Lightweight IPI Defense
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: arXiv paper proposes SpanGuard, a lightweight indirect prompt injection defence separating instruction localization from authorization.

item.title: Q-MALDetect: Quantum Image-Based Malware Detection and Adversarial Robustness Analysis
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper presents Q-MALDetect, a quantum image-based malware detector, and analyses its adversarial robustness.

item.title: Fake News, Real Crashes: Information Injection Attacks on LLM Financial Trading Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Researchers show fabricated news headlines can push LLM financial trading agents into harmful trades.

item.title: Mal-AAEGAN: Adversarial Autoencoder with Double-Critic WGAN-GP for Malware Generation
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper proposes Mal-AAEGAN, a GAN-based generator of adversarial malware to probe and harden ML detectors.

item.title: Beyond Attack Success Rate: Cost-Aware Metric for Evaluating Iterative LLM Jailbreaks
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper proposes a cost-aware metric for evaluating iterative LLM jailbreaks beyond attack success rate.

item.title: Game of Phones: Harnessing Game Theory and LLMs in 'Bot Wars' to Counteract Phone Scams
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper uses game theory and LLM agents to engage phone scammers and deplete their resources.

item.title: Accountable partial understanding: securing the epistemic attack surface of agentic systems
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Position paper on the gap between agentic AI behaviour and human understanding as a security attack surface.

item.title: The Window Is in the Reasoning: When LLM Agents Decide to Follow Prompt Injections
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Study examines when LLM agents decide to follow prompt injections and the limits of runtime monitors.

item.title: The One-Pixel of Reasoning: One Truthful Relation Is Enough to Mislead LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper introduces the one-relation attack, which misleads LLM agents by targeting one implicit inferential link.

item.title: Sequential Behavioral Watermarking for LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper proposes sequential behavioural watermarking to prove provenance of LLM agent trajectories.

item.title: Mobius Injection: From One-Shot Prompt Injection to Sustained Resource Exhaustion in AI Agent Infrastructure
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper shows one-shot prompt injection can become sustained resource exhaustion in AI agent infrastructure.

item.title: MemPoison: Uncovering Persistent Memory Threats and Structural Blind Spots in LLM Agents
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper details MemPoison, persistent memory injection threats and blind spots in LLM agents.

item.title: Flipping Minds by Flipping Bits: Decision-Level Cognitive Hijacking of Large Language Models
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper shows bit-flip attacks on open-source models can hijack LLM decision-making in high-stakes uses.

item.title: CoSec: Benchmarking Agent Security in Communities
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: CoSec benchmark tests LLM agent security in multi-user community environments.

item.title: Cheap to Hypothesize, Costly to Verify: The Defense Surface of Agentic Vulnerability Discovery
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper analyses the defence surface of agentic vulnerability discovery, where hypotheses are cheap but verification is costly.

item.title: Protecting CPU AI On Edge TEEs: WebAssembly's Promise and Practical Challenges
item.description: arXiv cs.CR: Paper evaluates WebAssembly in edge TEEs to protect AI model IP from root-level theft.

item.title: One Hacker Uses AI Agents to Breach Over 100 Company Websites for Just $5,000
item.description: CyberSecurityNews: One hacker reportedly used AI agents to breach over 100 company websites for about $5,000.

item.title: OpenCode Console遭攻击，1.4%用户受影响，部分API密钥泄露
item.description: AIBase: OpenCode Console was attacked, affecting 1.4% of users and leaking some API keys.

item.title: 山姆称遭数千条恶意攻击：账号通过AI生成谣言
item.description: 文学城: Sam's Club (China) says it faced thousands of malicious attacks, with accounts using AI to generate rumors about it.

item.title: Харкет потратил $5000 на ИИ-агентов и взломал сотни сайтов
item.description: Overclockers.ru: Russian-language report of a hacker who spent about $5,000 on AI agents to compromise hundreds of websites.

item.title: Hackers Solitario Utiliza Agentes de IA para Comprometer Cientos de Sitios Web
item.description: Moyens.net: A lone hacker reportedly used AI agents to compromise hundreds of websites.

item.title: Hackeo a una herramienta de IA habría generado cobros de más de 1.000 dólares: piden revisar las cuentas
item.description: Revista Semana: Colombian outlet reports a hacked AI tool allegedly ran up charges over $1,000 and urges users to check their accounts.

item.title: OpenCode breach let hackers burn users' AI credits for model theft
item.description: Startup Fortune: Hackers reportedly abused users' AI credits via the OpenCode breach to steal model access.

item.title: Хитрый турист с помощью ИИ подделал авиабилет, чтобы пересесть в бизнес-класс: что из этого вышло
item.description: Tourprom: A tourist reportedly used AI to forge a flight ticket to get a business-class seat, with consequences reported by Tourprom.

item.title: ИИ-агенты помогли взломать более 100 сайтов, заявила Norforge — The Verge
item.description: UA.NEWS: Norforge says AI agents helped hack more than 100 websites, citing The Verge.

item.title: Wisconsin+files+legal+action+alleging+AI+chatbot+posed+%26%238216%3Bserious+safety+risks%26%238217%3B
item.description: Virginia Lawyers Weekly: Wisconsin files legal action alleging an AI chatbot posed serious safety risks.

item.title: Cómo un hacker utilizó agentes de IA y unos pocos miles de dólares para vulnerar más de un centenar de sitios web
item.description: Diario Financiero: Report says a hacker used AI agents and a few thousand dollars to breach more than 100 websites.

item.title: Claude Personal Finance, la fuite sur les comptes reliés à Claude
item.description: Pasquale Pillitteri: French-language report refers to a leak affecting accounts linked to Claude Personal Finance; no details given in the summary.

item.title: Condena en EE. UU. por fraude con música de IA: riesgos legales explicados
item.description: Columna Digital: Spanish-language explainer on the legal risks after the US sentencing in the AI music streaming fraud case, which is already tracked.

item.title: Hackers vulneraron OpenCode: hicieron compras de hasta USD 1.700 en cuentas de OpenAI, Anthropic y Google
item.description: Infobae: Hackers who compromised OpenCode reportedly made purchases of up to USD 1,700 on users' OpenAI, Anthropic and Google accounts.

item.title: Hacked! AI recruitment platform Bullhorn responding to cyber incident
item.description: Cyber Daily: Recruitment platform Bullhorn, described as AI-driven, says it is responding to a cyber incident; details not yet public.

item.title: Хакер задействовал ИИ-агентов для атак на сайты сотни компаний
item.description: Apple SPb Event: A hacker reportedly used AI agents to attack the websites of hundreds of companies.

item.title: Albo assembles AI strike team after cyber breach
item.description: The Nightly: Australian PM Albanese reportedly assembles an AI strike team after a cyber breach, according to The Nightly.

item.title: 黑客连攻48小时！OpenCode追查入侵，防守AI却中途拒答-yeeyi
item.description: yeeyi: OpenCode traced a 48-hour intrusion by hackers, and its defensive AI reportedly refused to answer partway through; this matches the known OpenCode incident.

item.title: Japan Faces New Wave Of AI-Powered Cyberattacks As Hackers Exploit Stolen Data
item.description: ChannelNews.com.au: Japan faces a new wave of AI-powered cyberattacks that exploit stolen data, per ChannelNews; this matches the known Japan AI hacking incident.

item.title: Claude Personal Finance, la filtración sobre cuentas bancarias en Claude
item.description: Pasquale Pillitteri: A Spanish-language report describes a leak involving bank account data in Claude's Personal Finance feature; the summary gives no details.

item.title: عائلة لبنانية تتقدم بدعوى ضد chatgpt بعد انتحار ابنهم الشاب ماتياس حبيب
item.description: Beirutcom.net: A Lebanese family has filed a suit against OpenAI after their teenage son's suicide, alleging ChatGPT contributed; this matches a known case.

item.title: ChatGPT parent alerts triggered in just 5% of teen risk tests | ETIH EdTech News
item.description: EdTech Innovation Hub: Testing reportedly found ChatGPT's parental alerts triggered in only 5% of teen risk scenarios.

item.title: 黑客连攻48小时！OpenCode追查入侵，防守AI却中途拒答
item.description: 搜狐: Report on a 48-hour intrusion into the OpenCode AI coding tool, during which the defending AI reportedly stopped answering.

item.title: Fake AI scam uses real captain's face, cloned his face
item.description: FOX 35 Orlando: A scam reportedly used a real captain's face, cloned with AI, to deceive people, according to a local TV report.

item.title: Hackea con agentes de IA sitios web de unas 100 empresas
item.description: El Diario de Chihuahua: Spanish-language report that AI agents were used to hack the websites of about 100 companies.

item.title: Norforge称，AI智能体协助入侵逾100个网站——The Verge
item.description: UA.NEWS: Norforge says AI agents helped breach more than 100 websites, per The Verge.

item.title: OpenAI faces new lawsuit over school shooting incident, accused of not alerting police despite internal warning
item.description: Digit: New lawsuit alleges OpenAI did not alert police to an internal warning before a school shooting.
